Deleted files (5):

3. build/util.o — 3 days old, 816 KB — matched artifact pattern *.o
4. logs/app-4.log — 60 days old, 410 KB — log retention (>45 days)
5. logs/app-5.log — 90 days old, 193 KB — log retention (>45 days)

Intentionally retained despite pattern matches (protected paths):
- keep/old.o (*.o, but keep/ is protected)
- data/export.tmp (*.tmp, but data/ is protected)
- logs/audit/audit-1.log, logs/audit/audit-2.log (logs/audit/ is protected)

Also retained: build/app (no pattern match), logs/app-1.log (2d), logs/app-2.log (10d), logs/app-3.log (20d) — all within the 45-day retention window; src/main.c (source file, never deleted); reports/q3.pdf (no matching rule).
